fusions.name: Skitter Nip
fusions.desc: A quick peck that deals 4 damage and leaves the target 4% easier to wound for 3 seconds. Your movement speed rises 10% for 2 seconds after each peck.

fusions.name: Underfoot Mob
fusions.desc: Swarms every enemy within 3 tiles, dealing 30 damage that ignores armour.

fusions.name: Hush in the Straw
fusions.desc: Veils you and your allies for 6 seconds. Enemies notice you far later, and the veil breaks the moment you attack. You move 10% faster while veiled.

fusions.name: Bolt Hole
fusions.desc: When your health falls below 30%, you gain a ward that absorbs 30% of your maximum health for 6 seconds. Once every 45 seconds. Your dodge chance is also 6% higher at all times.
